summary: This app uses zero experimental, preview, or canary APIs — every React Router API in it (ssr config, @react-router/express adapter, data(), typed route modules, standard component exports) is long-stable in the current v8.5.x release, and it correctly steers clear of the unstable features introduced in v8.4/v8.5.
